name: Printersmark
description: A cross with a ring at its centre and short ticks at the ends.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(46.0% 0.0%, 54.0% 0.0%, 54.0% 46.0%, 100.0% 46.0%, 100.0% 54.0%, 54.0% 54.0%, 54.0% 100.0%, 46.0% 100.0%, 46.0% 54.0%, 0.0% 54.0%, 0.0% 46.0%, 46.0% 46.0%); clip-path: polygon(46.0% 0.0%, 54.0% 0.0%, 54.0% 46.0%, 100.0% 46.0%, 100.0% 54.0%, 54.0% 54.0%, 54.0% 100.0%, 46.0% 100.0%, 46.0% 54.0%, 0.0% 54.0%, 0.0% 46.0%, 46.0% 46.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 26%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 34%, #000 34% 48%, transparent 48%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 34%, #000 34% 48%, transparent 48%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
